system.description:
As a Bonus action, by spending 1 Viper Blood, you elongate your fangs like that of a snakes and gain the Serpents Bite, until the beginning of your next turn.

In place of an attack made as part of the Attack Action, Opportunity attack or a Hijutsu you cast; you can make a Serpent Bite allowing you to use your clans Hijutsu ability modifier as defined by Hijutsu Flexibility.

Serpent Bite. Make an unarmed attack, dealing 3d6+your modifier in Poison damage on a hit, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw, gaining a rank of Envenomed on a failure. Increase the damage of this Bite by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels. Also increase the ranks of Envenomed by +1 at 7th and 15th levels.
